env.device: Samsung Galaxy S25 FE (SM-S731B), adb serial R5CY83QNZ1Y
env.build: Hermes release, New Architecture, JS dev=false; bytecode compiled with hermesc -O and swapped into the example release APK (debug keystore), scratch clone, not the worktree
env.harness: scratch clone example/src/s5/sim.ts (same sim + core harness as the 2026-11-06 release run) with F2 variants; each round runs all six fixtures back to back (interleaved); core = createMarkdownStreamCoreWith

variants.orig: F2 as in bench/fixtures/index.ts (9724 chars), control
variants.R: F2 with "footnotes[^perf]." -> "footnotes." and the final line "[^perf]: Measured on device in release builds; see the benchmark protocol." removed (9642 chars, -82)
variants.P: as R, but the definition line kept as a plain paragraph without the "[^perf]: " prefix (9708 chars, -16); same block structure as orig

env.cpuMode: Rounds 0-1 (warm-up) ran at a full parse of 15.9-18.1 ms; from round 2 on the CPU ran in a ~2x slower mode (full parse 29.6 ms, stable to +-0.1 ms) for the rest of the session, so all 20 measured rounds are slow-mode. The slow mode is the same for all six fixtures (interleaved), so the ratios compare like with like. `cmd power set-fixed-performance-mode-enabled true` was tried mid-run and made no difference (reset to false afterwards).
env.gfx: not collected (core/sim only, no React runs)

calibration.rule: round flagged slow if cal > 1.5 x median of measured rounds
